decisions: Admit Coinbase/Ripple RLUSD listing, BNY XRP/RLUSD custody, Aviva tokenization, Ripple Prime RLUSD collateral, C2FO Instant Pay, Ripple Treasury and Robinhood to event timeline with live/planned/announced states separated.

Record Ripple National Trust Bank as OCC-effective; Ripple describes segregated RLUSD reserve management, collateral trustee and fiduciary custody powers. Standard Custody & Trust Company remains RLUSD issuer.
Treat Ripple Prime RWA-swap collateral as RLUSD, not XRP. Coinbase Global Exchange and SC/LMAX collateral paths remain planned at capture.
Treat BNY XRP/RLUSD custody as institutional custody access, not proof of AUC or XRP purchases.
Treat C2FO Instant Pay as receivables financing by participating capital providers with RLUSD settlement on XRPL; waitlist is not production volume.
Treat Aviva GBP 50M as fund-share capital with underlying assets off-chain, not XRP.
Treat Coinbase Q3 USDC metrics and Circle distribution economics as platform context; Q3 net income is materially affected by crypto-investment gains.
Treat SBI as multi-rail with Circle/USDC/Arc and Ripple/XRP/RLUSD; no exclusivity.
Resolve SBIC in this context as Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.; repeated ChatGPT/GenAI seminars are educational, not an OpenAI partnership.
Evaluate XRPL-Utilities free reads/MCP as an independent adapter; paid USD 0.10 x402 scans were not used or authorized.
Keep ETF and derivatives provider series separate; no daily ETF-flow feature or composite OI feature admitted.
Treat Binance Update #3's 90% replenishment and top-ten 1:1 coverage including XRP as company claims; no XRP-specific purchase quantity disclosed.
required_verification: BNY custody balances and direct RLUSD mint/redeem launch
C2FO Instant Pay production volume and funded receivables
Aviva tokenized share units, holders, subscriptions/redemptions and XRPL fees
Ripple Prime RWA OI and RLUSD collateral balances
SBI accumulation/rewards/points units and inventory sourcing
XRP ETF issuer shares outstanding and holdings
XRPL-Utilities free endpoints against independent XRPL node and issuer data
actual_capital_policy: A fund share subscription, receivables advance, stablecoin balance, issuer reserve, exchange inventory, reward credit, ETF AUM change, share creation/redemption and XRP spot/OTC execution are distinct. Only reconciled XRP execution or holdings acquisition is XRP purchase capital.
